prompts.text: Did Adam and Eve live in the Garden of Eden?
prompts.explanation: Genesis 2:8 states that God planted a garden in Eden and put Adam there.

prompts.text: Did Noah take two of every animal onto the ark?
prompts.explanation: Genesis 7:9 describes animals going into the ark two by two.

prompts.text: Did Moses encounter a burning bush that was not consumed?
prompts.explanation: Exodus 3:2 describes the angel of the Lord appearing in a burning bush that was not consumed.

prompts.text: Did David defeat Goliath with a sword?
prompts.explanation: 1 Samuel 17:50 states David defeated Goliath with a sling and stone, not a sword.

prompts.text: Was Jonah swallowed by a whale?
prompts.explanation: Jonah 1:17 mentions a 'great fish', not specifically a whale.
Matthew 2:1 states Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea.
